panels.title: Questions par thème
panels.description: Une part par QUESTION posée (et non par session). Le thème est déduit du texte de la question : le préfixe de langue ([EN], [FR]...) est retiré, puis la première règle qui matche gagne — d'où l'ordre, du sujet le plus spécifique au plus général. Le vocabulaire est tiré du corpus RAG (app/src/main/python/docs/data.csv, 985 questions) : il couvre donc les sujets que le robot sait réellement traiter. Les questions de moins de 20 caractères non classées sont comptées comme incomplètes (ASR tronqué).

targets.query:
import "strings"
import "regexp"
from(bucket: "temi")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "conversation_logs" and r._field == "question")
  |> map(fn: (r) => {
      q = strings.toLower(v: r._value)
      body = strings.trimSpace(v: regexp.replaceAllString(r: /^\[[a-z]{2}\]\s*/, v: q, t: ""))
      theme =
        if regexp.matchRegexpString(r: /library|borrow|loan|magazine|\bdvd/, v: body) then "Bibliothèque"
        else if regexp.matchRegexpString(r: /bursary|scholarship|financial|subsidy|\bfees?\b|tuition|cost|price|payment|how much/, v: body) then "Bourses & Frais"
        else if regexp.matchRegexpString(r: /result|grade|\bgpa\b|transcript|assessment|attendance|graduation|gown|certificate|\bcert\b/, v: body) then "Résultats & Diplôme"
        else if regexp.matchRegexpString(r: /robot|cortex|artificial intelligence|\bai\b|mechatronic|automation/, v: body) then "Robotique & IA"
        else if regexp.matchRegexpString(r: /module|elective|course|\bgsms?\b|curriculum|semester|academic|diploma|subject|lecture/, v: body) then "Modules & Cours"
        else if regexp.matchRegexpString(r: /regist|withdrawal|deferment|transfer|application|apply|admission|enrol|\bform\b|submit|appeal/, v: body) then "Démarches & Inscription"
        else if regexp.matchRegexpString(r: /politemall|polymall|blackboard|portal|wifi|log ?in|sign ?in|password|account|helpdesk|\bprint|email/, v: body) then "Services numériques"
        else if regexp.matchRegexpString(r: /\bcard\b|matric/, v: body) then "Carte étudiant"
        else if regexp.matchRegexpString(r: /\bjob\b|\becg\b|career|internship|resume|counsellor/, v: body) then "Carrière & Stage"
        else if regexp.matchRegexpString(r: /medical|clinic|\bmc\b|sick|doctor|wellness/, v: body) then "Santé"
        else if regexp.matchRegexpString(r: /club|\bcca\b|society|\bsla\b|student life|activit|event|orientation/, v: body) then "Clubs & Vie étudiante"
        else if regexp.matchRegexpString(r: /canteen|koufu|cafe|food|\beat\b|drink|meal|lunch|snack/, v: body) then "Restauration"
        else if regexp.matchRegexpString(r: /pool|swim|gym|sport|stadium|court|fitness|makerspace|t-junction|facilit|booking/, v: body) then "Sport & Installations"
        else if regexp.matchRegexpString(r: /\bblk\b|block|level|\broom\b|toilet|lift|entrance|carpark|campus|central/, v: body) then "Lieux & Campus"
        else if regexp.matchRegexpString(r: /where|go to|take me|bring me|find|located|how do i get|show me/, v: body) then "Directions"
        else if strings.strlen(v: body) < 20 then "Question incomplète"
        else "Autre"
      return {_value: 1.0, theme: theme}
    })
  |> group(columns: ["theme"])
  |> sum(column: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["theme", "_value"])
  |> yield(name: "by_theme")

from(bucket: "temi")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "conversations" and r._field == "duration_s")

  |> yield(name: "conversations_per_day")

panels.title: Détections vs Conversations par jour
panels.description: Combien de personnes détectées finissent par vraiment converser (taux de transformation).

targets.query:
detections = from(bucket: "temi")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "robot_events" and r.event_type == "face_detected" and r._field == "count")
  |> group()
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: sum, createEmpty: true)
  |> fill(value: 0)
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "Détections")
conversations = from(bucket: "temi")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "conversations" and r._field == "duration_s")
  |> group()
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: count, createEmpty: true)
  |> fill(value: 0)
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "Conversations")
union(tables: [detections, conversations])
  |> yield(name: "funnel")

panels.title: Utilisation des fonctions
panels.description: Nombre d'utilisations : photo, QR code, appel à un prof.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "temi")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "robot_events" and r._field == "count" and (r.event_type == "photo_taken" or r.event_type == "qr_shown" or r.event_type == "prof_call"))
  |> group(columns: ["event_type"])
  |> sum()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with fonction:
        if r.event_type == "photo_taken" then "Photo"
        else if r.event_type == "qr_shown" then "QR code"
        else "Appel prof" }))
  |> group(columns: ["fonction"])
  |> keep(columns: ["fonction", "_value"])
  |> yield(name: "features")

panels.title: Thèmes par jour
panels.description: Répartition des thèmes de conversation dans le temps (barres empilées).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "temi")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "conversations" and r._field == "duration_s")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with theme:
        if exists r.topic and r.topic == "directions" then "Directions"
        else if exists r.topic and r.topic == "library" then "Bibliothèque"
        else if exists r.topic and r.topic == "clubs" then "Clubs / CCA"
        else if exists r.topic and r.topic == "admin" then "Admin / Inscription"
        else if exists r.topic and r.topic == "facilities" then "Installations"
        else "Autre" }))
  |> group(columns: ["theme"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: count, createEmpty: true)
  |> fill(value: 0)
  |> yield(name: "themes_per_day")

panels.title: Activité par heure de la journée
panels.description: À quelles heures le robot est le plus sollicité (waves + conversations, fuseau Singapour).

targets.query:
import "date"
import "timezone"
option location = timezone.location(name: "Asia/Singapore")
from(bucket: "temi")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => (r._measurement == "robot_events" and r._field == "count") or (r._measurement == "conversations" and r._field == "duration_s"))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _value: 1.0, heure: date.hour(t: r._time) }))
  |> group(columns: ["heure"])
  |> sum(column: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["heure"])
  |> yield(name: "by_hour")

from(bucket: "temi")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "conversation_logs" and (r._field == "question" or r._field == "answer"))
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "session_id", "topic"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "session_id", "topic", "question", "answer"])
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
